chat.consentPublic: Messages in the global room are public and permanent. There is no delete.
chat.consentIp: The relay server sees your IP address and when you are online. Your wallet does not.
chat.consentSeparate: Your chat name is separate from your wallet. Nobody can see your balance or your payments.
chat.consentOff: You can turn this off again in Settings.
chat.errSend: That message did not go out. Check the connection and try again.
chat.errEngine: This build does not include the chat engine, so messages cannot be signed.
chat.nameWhy: Shown next to your messages. You can change it later, and you can skip it and post as anon.
chat.namePermanent: Posts are public and permanent — anyone can read them, and they cannot be deleted.
chat.readOnly: This device has no key, so it can read the room but not post.
chat.tipAddrWhy: Publishing an address lets people tip you. It links this chat name to a payment destination, so leave it empty to stay unlinkable.

actions.reportConfirm: Tap again to report and mute

profile.muteNote: Muting is yours alone. It hides them for you; nobody can remove a person from the network.

toast.muted: Muted. You will not see their messages.

dm.title: Messages
dm.note: Only the two of you can read this. Relays see a one-time key, not who is talking to whom.
dm.needKey: Ask them to post once so their key is known.

chat.intro: Everyone here can read what you post, and posts cannot be deleted. Use the row above to change room. Tap a message to react or reply, or swipe it to reply.
chat.torBlocked: Chat is off because Tor is on. The relay is reached directly, not through Tor, so connecting would show it your real IP address. Either switch Tor off, or set a relay with an .onion address in Settings.
chat.torBlockedShort: Not connected while Tor is on.

muted.title: Muted people
muted.note: Muting only affects this wallet. Unmuting brings their messages back everywhere you are signed in with this seed.

chat.bioWhy: Shown on your profile to anyone in the room. Public and permanent, like a message. {{n}} characters left.
